validity_domain: Protocol-convention CBE/RBE weights as applied at FiR 1 and in the inter-facility standard-model comparisons (TECDOC-1223): RBE 3.2 for the nitrogen capture and hydrogen recoil components, CBE_boron 3.8 in the 'tumor' region and 1.0 elsewhere, photon weight 1.0 by definition of the photon-isoeffective convention. Applies to trace-loaded phantom dosimetry only as a weighting convention — no clinical claim; the phantom boron loading is dilute (~0.1 ppm) so absolute weighted doses are not treatment-representative.
